payload.friendly_name: Consolidate retarget adopts the override target
payload.purpose_context: Today consolidate --target <other> is refused whenever the recorded target differs (TARGET_OVERRIDE_RECORDED_TARGET_UNWRITABLE, #5783), because part of the bookkeeping resolves meta.json's recorded target. This Mission adds an explicit, recorded retarget so the override becomes the Mission's new recorded target and every write lands there, with abort/resume/rollback honouring it.
payload.purpose_tldr: Let an operator retarget a Mission at consolidation so the landing and all its bookkeeping land on one new recorded target.

payload.question: Is the retarget an explicit opt-in (--retarget requiring --target) or implicit on --target?

options: up front, first mutation, own commit with provenance on the new PRIMARY checkout (rec)
payload.question: When and where is meta.json target_branch rewritten?

options: persist retarget in run record; one rollback authority restores; resume honours; ADR amendment (rec)
payload.question: How do --resume, --abort and the rollback authority treat a retargeted run?

options: never bypasses: #6464 + #5385 probes judge the new target up front (rec)
payload.question: How does a retarget interact with #6464 and the status-write policy?

options: dry-run forecasts identically; orchestrator-api refuses retargets (no rollback door) (rec)
payload.question: --dry-run and orchestrator-api consolidate-mission parity?

payload.final_answer: Operator ruling 2026-11-17 (relayed by core triager): explicit --retarget, requires --target; plain --target keeps TARGET_OVERRIDE_RECORDED_TARGET_UNWRITABLE; its next step names --retarget.

Operator ruling 2026-11-17 (relayed by core triager): up front: in effect before the pre-mutation snapshot; meta.json target_branch rewrite committed as the first mutation inside the rollback door, with provenance {from,to,actor,at,reason}; --retarget-reason optional with a default.

Operator ruling 2026-11-17 (relayed by core triager): retarget persisted in ConsolidationState; the one rollback authority restores it; --resume honours it and never re-commits; ADR 2026-09-19-1 amendment.
Operator ruling 2026-11-17 (relayed by core triager): never bypasses: #6464 and #5385 judge the new target before anything is written.

Operator ruling 2026-11-17 (relayed by core triager): --dry-run forecasts the retarget with the same codes; orchestrator-api consolidate-mission refuses a retarget (no rollback door), no contract change.
